# dsh-restart-switch

One restart switch for DeepSeek Harness: a small
button in the composer toolbar that offers **restar

t the kernel** or **restart the
whole DSH app**.
## Two restart targets
| Action | What it does | What you lose |
| **Restart kernel** | Recomposes the profile through the live HMR service: the manifest and patch f
iles are read again, changed plugin modules are replaced, stopped entries are started, and the plugi
n tree is judged again. The page reloads so the browser half picks up the new composition. | Nothing

but the page reload — the Host process, the HTTP server and the desktop window stay alive. |
| **Re
start DSH** | Relaunches the whole application. A detached helper stops the desktop shell, lets the
Host finish its graceful shutdown, then starts the application executable again. Outside the desktop
shell it re-spawns the same process command instead. | Running tasks are interrupted. The menu asks
for confirmation first. |

Both actions report their state in the menu, including the failure message, so a
broken plugin or a
refused restart is visible instead of silently doing nothing.

## Where the button lives

The trigger registers in `conversation.input.right` — the compact controls just
left of the composer

submit button. It was originally written for
`sidebar.footer.action`, but sidebar skins that take t

he footer over (for example
`dsh-claude-style`) hide every footer entry that is not their own update

seat, so
the button would be invisible exactly where it was asked for. The composer row is
always r
endered, in every skin.
The menu itself registers in `shell.overlay`, so it is never clipped by a column.
## Configuration
| Field | Default | Meaning |

| `kernelDelayMs` | `120` | Delay between the RPC response and the profile recomposition. |
| `appDe
layMs` | `1500` | Delay between the RPC response and the relaunch helper acting. |
Override them in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## How it works

- `index.js` registers the `restartSwitch` service (`restartKernel`, `restartApp`)
and marks both me

thods as direct Remote endpoints, which is what lets the page
call them over `ctx.connection.rpc`.
-

`restartKernel` uses `ctx.hmr.runExclusive(() => ctx.hmr.reconcileProfile())` —
the same path DSH i

tself uses when a profile file changes on disk.
- `restartApp` spawns `relaunch.js` detached before

anything is torn down. In the
desktop shell the helper stops the Electron process, waits for this Ho

st to exit
(its IPC parent going away is what triggers the graceful shutdown), and starts
the applic

ation executable again.
- `client.js` registers the toolbar trigger and the overlay menu, sharing on

e tiny
store between them.
## Requirements

- DSH `0.2.1-rc.5` or later within the `0.2.x` line (`engines.dsh`).
- A profile with live HMR for t

he kernel restart; without it the menu reports
`kernel-restart-unavailable` instead of pretending to

nel restart; without it the menu reports
`kernel-restart-unavailable` instead of pretending to work.
